reviews.text: Every pet i've ever had i have brought them here for checkups, sickness, etc. In the past years they have had a new/ different tech. Earlier this year i had to bring my dog in as he was screaming in pain every time he tried to use the bathroom. The vet here (graphic sorry) put his finger in his behind and swore he was fine and did not have an enlarged prostate. Charged me nearly $300 that day and had my dog take medication for an "infection". Low and behold he definitely did have an enlarged prostate and had to have an emergency neutering by a much better vet. SAVE YOUR MONEY. do not go here.

This vet (John) is unprofessional and injection happy and takes no accountability. My cat has a heart issue he failed to diagnose. I took her in for a simple bald spot she had licked into her arm and the vet injected her without informing me what it was or the potential side effects. Within a week my cat could barely breathe which led to x-rays, ECG’s, medication, and several follow up appointments totaling well over $2K to correct. When confronted with these issues John’s attitude towards the situation was “how was I supposed to know the cat had a heart issue”. When asked why he did not go into detail about the injection he gave my cat he got agitated and tried to deny doing so. My last straw was when John stated “I should be happy to now know my cat has a health issue so I can work on getting it treated”. My response was why the eff would I be happy you made it difficult for my cat to breathe?! Hearing “what the eff” was too much for his delicate cat killing ears so he became irate and hung up the phone. I left several messages with the office manager LESLIE regarding a refund for the services that rendered my cat unable to breathe however she never returned a single phone call nor made any attempts to contact me. To my understanding Leslie is more upset that I said what the eff to the doctor than she is that the doctor is making pets sick and costing owners thousands and by the look of these reviews it’s not just my pet.

Extremely disappointing and unprofessional experience. I felt like my concerns were barely listened to, and the vet Dr. Mucera seemed more interested in ordering test after test than actually taking the time to carefully evaluate my pet’s symptoms and discuss what could be going on.

The appointment felt rushed, impersonal, and transactional. Instead of feeling like my pet was being thoughtfully examined, I felt like I was being handed a list of tests and bills. A good veterinarian should take the time to listen, observe the symptoms, explain their reasoning, and make the owner feel confident that their animal is actually being cared for—not make you feel like an open wallet.

I left feeling frustrated, unheard, and questioning whether my pet’s well-being was really the priority. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this vet and will be looking elsewhere for someone who actually takes the time to examine the animal and communicate with the owner.

All of my pets get great care at this office. We’ve been going for years. My cats and dog are very loved and treated with respect even during difficult vet visits. I recommend to anyone in the area. Dr. M kept my pet very comfortable during his senior years I will always be grateful ♥️
It was wonderful I took my 3 newborn puppies they git their 1st vacation Veterinary checked the 3 of them he was nice and kind. Love it

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!! My dog passed 3 years ago because the vet was incompetent and careless. He said my dog’s kidney/pee was weird but he should be all fine. Didn’t dig any deeper and my dog died within the following week. All they want is your money and don’t care about your pet. It’s been 3 years and I genuinely have to say I have the same hate in my heart for them now as when he passed.

I cannot say enough good things about this clinic and the amazing team that helped my dogs, Taz and his brother.
When I brought Taz in because he was experiencing bleeding from his penis, I was understandably very worried. From the moment we walked through the door, Veronica at the front desk was welcoming, compassionate, and professional. She immediately helped make a stressful situation feel more manageable.
Dr. Mucera was outstanding. He took the time to thoroughly examine Taz, explain everything clearly, answer all of my questions, and make sure I understood the treatment plan. His knowledge and patience gave me a lot of confidence and peace of mind.
The veterinary technicians were equally incredible. Angela and Carmen were so kind and gentle while drawing Taz’s blood. They treated him with such care that he remained comfortable throughout the process, which means a lot to me as a pet owner. I also appreciated the technician who checked in on Taz and made sure he was doing well every step of the way.
On another visit, Leslie helped care for Taz and was just as wonderful—professional, attentive, and genuinely caring. It is clear that everyone at this clinic truly loves animals and takes pride in providing exceptional care.
What stood out most was how comfortable Taz felt around the staff. Anyone who owns a dog knows how important that is. Every person we interacted with treated him as if he were their own pet.
Thank you to Veronica, Dr. Mucera, Angela, Carmen, Leslie, and the entire team for your kindness, professionalism, and dedication. Taz and I are incredibly grateful for the care you provided. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly goes above and beyond.

One of the WORST VETS EVER. VET John Mucera CLEARLY SHOULD BE NO WHERE NEAR ANIMALS. POSSIBLY EVEN RACIST. first of all he didn’t introduce himself he straight up ask  “What does Siete mean?”. I told him what it meant. Then he started counting “1-7” in Spanish then said outloud while looking at the vet tech “you see I’m learning unlike…” while looking directly at her. mind you the tech didn’t even react or say anything to him. He then starts commenting “YOU SEE she’s always mean to me! She always treats me like this” it came off very passive aggressive and UNPROFESSIONAL. then he takes out my cat out the carrier and aggressively holds my cat. By the head. He Doesn’t even say anything or ask any other questions just tells the vet tech to hold my cat. Then JOHN decides it would be cute to start taunting my cat. By poking my cat behind. At that moment I wanted to grab my cat back and just walk out. But I was desperate for my cat to get some sort of treatment. Then he injected my cat so aggressively. That my cat hisses. Instead of pausing, he said aggressively“you gotta trust me” then he aggressively injects my cat again while shaking my cats skin…. I ended up paying $250 for injections that I don’t even know what is for. He also didn’t tell me what was wrong with my cat. I made a complaint to the manager and was offered to have my cat checked at a different location. I rejected the offer because why would I trust you guys after this incident.

UPDATE: My cat DID NOT get better. I ended up taking him to another clinic where they were thorough, Gentle, and treated Both of us WITH RESPECT. Not only that but they stated that the injections were unnecessary. Not only that but I got banned from this clinic and all their 3 locations after making the complaint and writing this review. I’m not mad that I got banned. I’m mad at the fact that this clinic really had the audacity to really think I was going to come back. Anyway I would still avoid this place and their other clinics.
